sloka: अर्धासनेन शक्रस्य राज्यार्धेन च पार्थिवः ।वन्द्यमानः सुरगणैः प्रतिज्ञामध्यरोहत ।। ७.६७.८ ॥
transliteration: ardhāsanena śakrasya rājyārdhena ca pārthivaḥ ।vandyamānaḥ suragaṇaiḥ pratijñāmadhyarohata ।। 7.67.8 ॥

translations.english: The king, Mandhata, who was honored with half of Indra's seat and half of his kingdom, and saluted by the hosts of gods, then undertook a challenge.
